text:
Chilly start this morning, with frost on the windshield and temperatures in the 20s. Clouds fill in through the morning and hang around, so it's a gray, somewhat dreary day. You might see streaks of rain falling from the clouds, but the air near the ground is so dry that nothing should reach you. Afternoon gets to near 53, a good bit warmer than yesterday, with only a light south breeze. Tonight stays mild for late October, with a low around 43 as the breeze picks up.

Thursday is the surprise. Sunshine and a gusty south wind push us to about 66, and the forecasters say we could even touch 70. Gusts of 25 to 30 mph by afternoon will be noticeable on a walk or ride. A cold front slides through in the evening. NWS keeps us dry, but the European model is wetter, so I'd expect a spotty shower after dark, just a few hundredths at most. Friday cools back into the 50s with a gusty northwest wind. Thursday is the day for a jacket, not an umbrella.
